# ar0x-wallpapers — Phase 9 ✅ COMPLETE

**Status:** real PKGBUILD with local `source=()` files and real SHA-256 sums.
**Contents:** 3× 4K PNG wallpapers, 3 SVG logo masters, CC BY-SA 4.0 LICENSE, GRUB `theme.txt`, SDDM `Main.qml` + `/usr/bin/ar0x-apply-wallpapers`.
**Installed at:** `/usr/share/ar0x/wallpapers/**`.
**Canonical sources:** `assets/wallpapers/**`, `assets/logo/**`, `assets/grub-theme/ar0x/theme.txt`, `assets/sddm/ar0x/Main.qml` (byte-identical mirrors regenerated by `./tools/setup-repo.sh --sync`).

`ar0x-apply-wallpapers` copies the 3 PNGs into `$XDG_PICTURES_DIR/ar0x/` (idempotent via `cmp -s`). It never writes to `/usr/share/backgrounds/ar0x/`.

## ⚠️ ADR-024 one-owner-per-path

This package does **NOT** install into any path already owned by the Phase 6/7
`archiso/airootfs/**` overlay (`/etc/skel/**`, `/usr/share/backgrounds/ar0x/**`,
`/usr/share/plymouth/**`, `/usr/share/grub/**`, `/usr/share/sddm/**`, hicolor
`ar0x-logo` icon, `/usr/share/ar0x/{branding,logo}/**`). `ar0x_repo.py::validate_ownership()`
fails the build if that rule is broken. See `/home/user/ar0xOS/docs/REPO_GUIDE.md §2`.

⚠️ `makepkg` / `namcap` / `shellcheck` were NOT run in this sandbox (RISK-049).
Build is a MANUAL gate on a clean `archlinux:base-devel` host/container.
